answer_1.quote: ConVA steers the intermediate layer embedding e l along the direction of the value vector v, ensuring that the response of the LLM follows the target value V.
datasets: Evaluation dataset with 100 open-ended questions per value
answer_1.outputs: Text responses to value-aligned scenarios (e.g., advice on dilemmas)

answer_2.quote: We employ LLM-based criteria to evaluate the effectiveness of our proposed ConVA framework. • Control Success Rate (CSR), we prompt GPT-4o to assess whether the outputs of the controlled model prioritize a specific value... • Fluency Rate (FR), we prompt GPT-4o to evaluate whether the answers generated by the controlled LLM are grammatically correct and fluent...

answer_3.quote: we prompt GPT-4o to assess whether the outputs of the controlled model prioritize a specific value and subsequently calculate the frequency of successful control.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study to evaluate the performance of our proposed ConVA... The labelers evaluated each output based on two criteria: • Control Success, Whether the output is aligned with the intended value. • Fluency, The linguistic fluency of the output.
answer_4.guideline: Labelers assessed outputs for alignment with intended values and linguistic fluency
